primary_focus: UC-21 foundation + Tier-3 full inventory: (1) Heartbeat + EnrollRequest now carry schema_version="1", agent_capabilities[] (auto-derived from dispatch handlers + feature flags), device_type="endpoint" — the server can gate feature rollouts without parsing agent_version strings and Phase-2 NMS "probe" fits non-breakingly. (2) New Tier-3 FullInventoryReport message carries a full HW + SW snapshot (CPU/RAM/disks/NICs/BIOS/chassis + installed_apps). Sent at startup, every AEGIS_FULL_INVENTORY_INTERVAL (default 6h), and ONCE on reconnect-after-offline with a flap floor (AEGIS_RECONNECT_SNAPSHOT_MIN_INTERVAL, default 1h) so a flapping NIC does not DoS the server. HW collector is PURE Go + registry + x/sys/windows — no WMI, no COM, no cgo — snapshot cost single-ms, binary growth <100 KB. Agent binary stays at 20.97 MB (budget 25 MB). Previous UC-20 Script content audit remains green.
